en:
- Four walls, at least one door, and a roof or ceiling creates a 'spare' room. Fill that room with furniture and decorations to create other types of room.
- To see what rooms you currently have in your settlement, turn the room overlay on <sprite="room_overlay_text_icon" index=t>.
- Take a look at the room type legend in the upper left corner to see what is needed for each room type, and what benefits that room offers.
- Some rooms are required for <LinkAlmanac="Eventypes">events</link>, e.g. you will need a great hall to host a <LinkAlmanac="Playertriggeredeventfeast">feast</link> event.
